purpose: Read-only source availability audit; not an effect measurement or frozen experiment protocol
population: race_horses.entry_status = EntryStatus.STARTED; joined to races and left joined to race_results
source: local PostgreSQL live read-only transaction; distinct from the frozen experiment snapshot
notes: Counts measure non-null storage only, not semantic validity or availability before each prediction cutoff.
Past-race results can only supply features strictly after those races; current-race results cannot be model inputs.
Current weight and weight_diff are unavailable before weight publication; full-information gains do not establish pre-publication gains.
Existing speed figure baseline mixes race classes within venue/track/distance/going cells. A condition correction would be a different hypothesis.
No external data acquisition or feature implementation was performed in this audit.
